A '''Fuel transporter''' was a type of [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] used by the [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|people]]
of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==Characteristics==
The fuel transporter was propelled by two thrusters and had its cockpit on the bottom of the superstructure. It was equipped with several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and could land on planetary surfaces.

==History==
Several of these tankers were used by the [[Tammuz-an shipping fleet]] to carry fuel for the [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] fleet. One such ship, the [[King's Ransom (transport)|''King's Ransom'']], was used in a ruse to divert the attention of pirate [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] and his gang away from the real transporter headed to Tammuz-an with a desperately needed replenishment of fuel.
